Dr. Althea - Vitamin C Boosting Serum

Korean Skincare

250 MAD

Dr. Althea Vitamin C Boosting Serum perks up lackluster skin with a careful blend of brightening, hydrating and soothing ingredients, including hippophae rhamnoides water for an antioxidant base naturally rich in Vitamin C. The serum’s Vitamin C content works in tandem with tranexamic acid, another brightening powerhouse, to fade dark spots and refine skin tone for more radiant, even-looking skin. Soothing centella asiatica leaf water, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid help keep moisture levels high and discomfort low. Why we love it: With its lightweight, stable and non-greasy formula, Dr. Althea Vitamin C Boosting Serum is a great option if you want a daily glow booster suitable for all skin types.
